name: capture formal Prefill Pod
command: kubectl get pod -n liangjiahao -l app=prefill -o json

name: capture formal Prefill NPU idle
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- npu-smi info

name: capture formal Master empty
command: kubectl exec -n liangjiahao deployment/prefill-engine-deployment -c prefill-engine -- python3 -c from\ urllib.request\ import\ urlopen\;\ print\(urlopen\(\'http://mooncake-master-service:9003/metrics\'\,timeout=10\).read\(\).decode\(\)\,end=\'\'\)
